description: Executable Candidate llama.cpp recipe based on NVIDIA's llama.cpp DGX Spark playbook (its hands-on example): the official ggml-org llama.cpp 0.5.0 CUDA 13 server image (arm64, pinned by digest; its default CUDA architectures include GB10 sm_121a) serving the exact GGUF revision through llama-server.
